_: WS-C (Home, Circle, invite, share, multi-circle, chat, pacts, calls): what differs from v0.8 on purpose.

newActions.c-switch: C36: put another of your circles on screen (people.circle, with circles[] reordered); every circle-scoped list is emptied first
newActions.share: C28: invite through navigator.share, else a wa.me link, else copy the link
newActions.send-retry: C38: resend a message that failed (it stays on screen as 'Not sent · Retry')

newSheets.circles: C36: your circles (up to the server's MAX_CIRCLES), the one on screen marked, and start or join another while there is room

changedSheets.invite: C28: Share invite / WhatsApp / Copy link under the QR; the QR and link use the same invite URL

screens.tab-today: C27/C29/C30/C32/C33: invite card on top until 3 members, then Needs you, own items, daily dare, a one-line Decode teaser, circle news, a one-line drops row; the lede counts the rows that need you
screens.tab-circle: C36/C40: 'N circles · switch' in the lede when you are in more than one; pacts show this week as M T W T F S S
screens.tab-city: C33: the Decode card on the map is the one-line teaser

behaviour.send: C38: a message shows as Sending… at once; if it fails it stays with Retry instead of vanishing; the same text can't be sent twice while the first is in flight
behaviour.leave: C36: leaving the circle on screen puts your next circle on screen (people.circle = the next of circles[]), instead of leaving you in none
behaviour.join: C36: joining a circle while in one adds it (up to MAX_CIRCLES) instead of refusing; a code for a circle you are already in switches to it
behaviour.names: C20: names are trimmed to 40 (people) and 28 (circles) at a word and never mid-grapheme, page and server; v0.8 cut people at 24 code units
